title: Swap "Hurry Up" for One Clear Cue
caption:
"Hurry up" tells them how we feel. "Next up: teeth" tells them what to do.

Same words, same calm voice, every morning.
After a few days it stops being a nag and starts being a cue.

Save it, try it tomorrow, and tell us how it lands.

#3rdgrademom #4thgrademom #schoolroutine #parentinghacks #steadydays
